summary: Hiker suffering a heart attack at ~11,438 ft near Iceberg Lake below the Continental Divide; Timberline Fire Protection District staged at East Portal and hiked up, working with Alpine Rescue to carry him across rocky terrain on a rope-belayed litter to a helispot at 11,000 ft by Clayton Lake. Gilpin County Sheriff's Office assisted; Rocky Mountain Rescue stood by. After an initial refusal over the 11,000-ft landing zone, a Flight for Life helicopter flew the patient out.
location: Iceberg Lake (East Portal / Moffat Tunnel area), below the Continental Divide
responding_agency: Timberline Fire Protection District; Alpine Rescue Team; Gilpin County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue (standby); Flight for Life
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: article says "Thursday, June 28, 2016" but June 28, 2016 was a Tuesday; 2016-06-30 was the Thursday of that week.
